findings.issue: The REQUEST A QUOTE button still ends only a few pixels above the tinted trustBar band, so it looks pushed into the band (unchanged since the last review).
findings.reference: The competitor's plain hero leaves an open white gap under its centred title and lead before the next module starts.
findings.fix: In template.css, give .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner a bottom padding (e.g. padding-block-end: calc(var(--section-space) / 2)) so a tinted neighbour never starts right under the hero's button.

findings.issue: On phones the REQUEST A QUOTE pill still touches the top edge of the tinted trustBar band, with no white space under it.
findings.reference: The competitor's phone hero ends with clear white space under its lead before the next module.
findings.fix: The same template change: a bottom padding on .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner.

findings.issue: The centred phone lead still ends in a short stray last line ('is made.') under four full centred lines.
findings.reference: The competitor's centred phone lead ends in a line close to the length of the lines above it.
findings.fix: In reference.css, set text-wrap: balance on .page-hero__lead so the centred lines even out.

findings.issue: Stacked one per row on phones, each contact card still carries a full-width black label bar at the desktop's 20px bold (.contact-channel__name font-size: 1.25rem on every width), so four heavy black bars dominate the screen.
findings.reference: The competitor's phone channel cards keep a compact black pill label with small type (about 14px) in each card.
findings.fix: In reference.css under max-width: 767px, set .contact-channels[data-variant="cards"] .contact-channel__name to a smaller font-size (about 1rem) and padding-block (about 0.375rem), keeping the one-column stack.

findings.issue: Fitted into its narrow side column, the process heading 'How a free quote moves from your files to a confirmed order' comes out barely larger than body text, smaller than the item titles of the next section (m3) and well below the page's other section headings, so it no longer reads as a section heading.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps every section heading on its page at one clear level above card and item titles.
findings.fix: In the template's heading fit, give a side-column (split) section heading a floor no smaller than the level below it (item/step titles), or widen the heading column so the fit does not shrink it under that floor.

findings.issue: The consent line still ends '…as described in the privacy policy. Privacy policy', repeating the link's words right after the sentence (the same on mobile).
findings.reference: The competitor's form carries no repeated text.
findings.fix: End the consent copy before the link (e.g. '…as described in our') or make 'privacy policy' inside the sentence the link.

findings.issue: The headings 'Contact details' and 'Send an enquiry' are still in sentence case, while the page's other section headings ('Frequently Asked Questions', 'What to Expect Once You Get in Touch', 'The Right Way to Reach Us for Each Request') are in title case.
findings.reference: The competitor sets all its contact-page headings in title case ('Contact Us', 'Have Questions?', 'Email Us').
findings.fix: Write the two headings in title case ('Contact Details', 'Send an Enquiry') in the page copy.
